book.name: Mɑɑku
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MAAKU U YORUA

content: Durɔ wìn nɔm teu ɡɑ ɡu
Mɑ Yesu u kpɑm duɑ mɛnnɔ yerɔ. Durɔ ɡoo wɑ̃ɑ mi, wìn nɔm teu ɡɑ ɡu.
Tɔmbɑ Yesu mɛɛrɑ bu wɑ ù n koo durɔ wi bɛkiɑ tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡiru sɔɔ, kpɑ bu kɑ wɑ bu nùn durum mɑni.
Mɑ u durɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ wìn nɔmu ɡɑ ɡu mi, u nɛɛ, ɑ seewo ɑ yɔ̃rɑ suunu sɔɔ.
Mɑ u tɔn be bikiɑ u nɛɛ, mbɑ n weenɛ bu tɔmbu kuɑ tɔ̃ɔ wɛ̃rɑruɡiru sɔɔ. Geɑ? Nɡe kɔ̃sɑ. N weenɛ bu tɔnu fɑɑbɑ ko? Nɡe bu nùn ɡo. Adɑmɑ bɑ mɑɑri.
Yesu u bu mɛɛrɑ kɑ mɔru u kɑ sikerenɑ, mɑ win nukurɑ sɑnkirɑ ben woo bɔbunun sɔ̃. Yerɑ u durɔ wi sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, ɑ wunɛn nɔmu dɛmiɔ. U ɡe dɛmiɑ mɑ ɡɑ wurɑ nɡe mɛ ɡɑ rɑɑ sɑ̃ɑ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ Fɑlisibɑ bɑ yɑrɑ mɑ bɑ yɑnde mɛnnɑ kɑ Herodun tɔmbu, bɑ wesiɑnɑ nɡe mɛ bɑ koo ko bu kɑ Yesu ɡo.
Tɔn wɔru ɡunɑ yɑ nɑ Yesun mi
Yesu kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ tii ɡɑwɑ bɑ dɑ Gɑlilen dɑɑ bureru ɡiɑ, mɑ tɔn wɔru ɡunɑ nùn swĩi. Tɔn be, bɑ nɑwɑ Gɑlilen di kɑ mɑɑ Yudeɑn tem di,
kɑ Yerusɑlɛmun di, kɑ Idumɛn tem di, kɑ Yuudɛnin ɡurun di, kɑ Tiri kɑ Sidonin bɑru kpɑɑnun di. Tɔn wɔru ɡunɑ ye, yɑ nɑ Yesun mi yèn sɔ̃ bɑ ye u mɔ̀ kpuron lɑbɑɑri nuɑ.
Tɔn wɔru ɡunɑ yen kpɑ̃ɑrun sɑɑbu Yesu u win bwɑ̃ɑbu sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, bu nùn ɡoo nimkuu sɔɔru kuo, kpɑ tɔn be, bu ku nùn bɑɑsi.
Yesu u rɑɑ tɔn dɑbinu bɛkiɑ, yen sɔ̃nɑ be bɑ bɑrɔ bɑ bɔrikiɑnɑmɔ bu wɑ bu kɑ nùn bɑbɑ.
Wɛrɛkunu nù n nùn wɑ nu rɑ nùn kpunɛwɑ kpɑ nu n kuuki mɔ̀ nu n ɡerumɔ, wunɑ Gusunɔn Bii.
Adɑmɑ Yesu u rɑ nu ɡerusi ɡem ɡem nu ku kɑ ɡere wi u sɑ̃ɑ.
Yesu u bwɑ̃ɑbu wɔkurɑ yiru ɡɔsɑ
Yen biru Yesu u dɑ ɡuuru wɔllɔ, mɑ u tɔmbu ɡɑbu sokɑ be u kĩ. Mɑ bɑ dɑ win mi.
Yerɑ u ben wɔkurɑ yiru ɡɔsɑ, [u bu yĩsiru kɑ̃ ɡɔrobu], be bɑ ko n kɑ nùn wɑ̃ɑ, kpɑ u bu ɡɔri bu Lɑbɑɑri ɡeɑ kpɑrɑ,
kpɑ u bu dɑm wɛ̃ bu kɑ wɛrɛkunu ɡirɑ.
Tɔnu wɔkurɑ yiru ye u ɡɔsɑ wee, Simɔɔ wi u yĩsiru kɑ̃ Piɛɛ,
kɑ Yɑkɔbu kɑ win wɔnɔ Yohɑnu, Sebeden bibu be u yĩsiru kɑ̃ Buɑnɛɡe, yen tubusiɑnɑ ɡuru kukirinuɡibu,
kɑ Andere, kɑ Filipu, kɑ Bɑɑtelemi, kɑ Mɑteu, kɑ Tomɑɑ, kɑ Yɑkɔbu Alufen bii, kɑ Tɑde, kɑ Simɔɔ wi u win tem ɡɑri kĩ,
kɑ sere Yudɑsi Isikɑriɔtu wi u tɔmbu Yesu nɔmu sɔndiɑ.
Yesun tɔmbu bɑ kĩ
bu kɑ nùn doonɑ
Mɑ bɑ wurɑ yɛnuɔ. Tɔn wɔru ɡɑ wure ɡɑ mɛnnɑ sere Yesu kɑ win bwɑ̃ɑbu bɑ fɛɛ biɑ bu di.
Sɑnɑm mɛ win dusibɑ ye nuɑ, bɑ dɑ bu kɑ nùn doonɑ min di, domi bɑ ɡerumɔ u wiirɑwɑ.
Yesu u kɑ tii yinɑmɔ
Mɑ woodɑ yɛ̃ro be bɑ wee sɑɑ Yerusɑlɛmun di bɑ ɡerumɔ bɑ mɔ̀, Beseburu u nùn wɑ̃ɑsiwɑ. Wɛrɛkunun sunɔ wiyɑ u nùn dɑm wɛ̃ u kɑ wɛrɛkunu ɡirɑ.
Yen sɔ̃nɑ Yesu u tɔmbu sokɑ mɑ u bu bikiɑ kɑ mɔndu u nɛɛ, ɑmɔnɑ Setɑm yɑ koo kpĩ yu yen tii ɡirɑ.
Bɑndun tɔmbu bɑ̀ n tɑbu mɔ̀ ben suunu sɔɔ, bɑn te, tɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ tu tɛ.
Yɛnu ɡèn tɔmbɑ mɑɑ sɑnkinɑmɔ, ɡɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ ɡu tɛ.
Setɑm yɑ̀ n mɑɑ kɑ yen tii tɑbu mɔ̀, yen dɑm mù n bɔnu kuɑ, yɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ yu tɛ, yen dɑm mu koo nɔru ko.
Goo kun kpɛ̃ u du dɑmɡiin yɛnuɔ u kɑ win yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ u kun ɡinɑ dɑmɡii wi bɔkue u sere win yɑ̃nu ɡurɑ.
Kɑ ɡeemɑ, nɑ bɛɛ sɔ̃ɔmɔ, torɑru kɑ ɡɑri kɑm kpuro ye tɔmbɑ ɡerumɔ, bɑ koo bu ye suuru kuɑ.
Adɑmɑ bɑɑwure wi u Hunde Dɛɛro ɡɑri kɑm ɡerusimɔ, u ǹ suuru wɑsi. Win torɑrɑ ko n mɑɑ nùn wɑ̃ɑsiwɑ kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Yesu u yeni ɡeruɑwɑ yèn sɔ̃ ɡɑbɑ nɛɛ wɛrɛkuwɑ ɡɑ nùn wɑ̃ɑsi.
Berɑ̀ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ Yesun wɔnɔbu
kɑ win mɛro
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ win wɔnɔbu kɑ win mɛro bɑ tunumɑ. Bɑ yɔ̃rɑ tɔɔwɔ, bɑ ɡoo ɡɔrɑ u nùn sokumɑ.
Tɔn wɔru ɡɑ sɔ̃ ɡɑ nùn sikerenɛ, mɑ ɡoo u nùn sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ, wee, wunɛn mɛro kɑ wunɛn wɔnɔbu bɑ yɔ̃ tɔɔwɔ bɑ nun soku.
Mɑ u nɛɛ, wɑrɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn mɛro. Berɑ̀ bɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn wɔnɔbu.
Mɑ u be bɑ nùn suunu bure mɛɛrɑ u kɑ sikerenɑ, mɑ u nɛɛ, nɛn mɛro kɑ nɛn wɔnɔbu wee.
Bɑɑwure wi u Gusunɔn kĩru mɔ̀, wiyɑ nɛn wɔnɔ, kɑ nɛn sesu, kɑ nɛn mɛro.
